title: Define the qualified experience contract
goal: Define scoped, attributable, correctable experience and an evaluation that can test later decisions without overstating limited evidence.
scope: Specify ExperienceVault behavior for qualified observations, knowledge, corrections, withdrawal, and reputation inputs.
Define how learning and retrieval costs enter the session resource record.
Define an evaluation on disjoint tasks with explicit baselines, evidence, and uncertainty.
acceptance: The reviewed contract requires every retained finding to have a source, scope, version, and supporting or contradicting evidence.
Corrections and withdrawals supersede prior use without erasing accountable history.
Reputation uses qualified attributable outcomes rather than confidence or participation volume.
The evaluation contract reports task sets, resource accounting, limitations, and whether observed evidence supports an improvement claim.
context: This task is intentionally unscheduled until checked result delivery provides versioned outcomes and evidence.
